newsitem.title: ITALY: Kok hopes Italy will be in EMU from start.
newsitem.headline: Kok hopes Italy will be in EMU from start.

text.p: Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok said on Tuesday the more countries that join the European single currency from the start, the better, adding that he hoped Italy would also make the grade.
"That depends on facts," he told reporters.
Kok was visiting Rome as part of preparations for a European Union summit in Amsterdam next month.

He declined to discuss the difficulties heavily-indebted Italy might have in reaching the criteria laid down in the Maastricht Treaty for EMU aspirants, saying the matter was not due to be decided until next year.
"I do not believe public declarations on this matter can be very productive at this moment," he said. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
